casper_htlc.name: Casper HTLC (bridge Casper leg)
casper_htlc.notes: ROADMAP L85 (multi-chain bridge, production). Byte-for-byte mirror of contracts/HTLC.sol (EVM leg on Sepolia) and server/bridge_htlc.py (deterministic mock). sha256 hashlock (not blake2b) so the same (preimage, hashlock) pair works on both legs of an atomic swap without adapter re-hashing. State machine EMPTY → LOCKED → CLAIMED | REFUNDED. Timelock in milliseconds to match Solidity+Python legs. Checks-Effects-Interactions ordering throughout. Deployer PEM: team.ae402_alexbelij_deployer_pem.
